paragraphs.text: Swanson ordered Amy and Claire to stay in his office, while he organized his officers.
Judge McIntosh, Lisa's father, was already on a plane with the money.
Everybody seemed to be busy doing something to help Lisa.
Amy and Claire felt like they were the only ones doing nothing.
We've got to do something, Claire.
Before Inspector Swanson came back, they walked out of the police station and into the late afternoon.
Which way do you think we should go?
Asked Claire, looking down the busy street.
She was looking at the photographs.
It was hard to believe that some of the photos were taken only a few days ago.
Why do you think she didn't tell us?
Claire turned around and realized that she was talking to herself.
Amy, you're not listening to me at all.
But she couldn't work out what it was.
I said, why do you think Lisa didn't tell us that she has a famous dad?
She said, showing the photos to Claire.
It's just us three having fun.
Claire took the photos from her and looked at them closely.
But she couldn't see anything unusual.
He's on this photo we took in Cairns and this one at Aries Rock.
He's even on photos that were taken before we came to Australia.
This one was taken at Heathrow Airport.
She was starting to get impatient now.
Amy wasn't making any sense and they didn't have time to waste like this.
Amy was pointing at the figure of a man with black hair in the background of the photos.
He's the monster who was kidnapped Lisa.
Said Claire, putting her hand on Amy's arm to calm her.
But she wasn't looking at the photo.
She was waving to a man across the street.
He walked quickly into a news agents.
I thought he was leaving Sydney.
You look like you've seen a ghost.
